cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
import compiler
from harness import check_plan

ok = fail = 0
worst = 0
for seed in range(12):
    random.seed(seed)
    N = 48
    edges = set()
    while len(edges) < 128:
        u = random.randrange(N); v = random.randrange(N)
        if u == v: continue
        key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
        if key in edges: continue
        edges.add(key)
    links = [(u, v) for u, v in sorted(edges)]
    parts = sorted(random.sample(range(N), 32))
    demands = {v: random.randrange(0, 5) for v in parts}
    if sum(demands.values()) == 0: demands[parts[0]] = 3
    rate = 40
    envelope = {i: rate for i in range(len(links))}
    period = 5
    caps = {l: period*rate for l in range(len(links))}
    t0 = time.time()
    plan, cut = compiler.compile_plan(N, links, envelope, period, parts, demands)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    worst = max(worst, dt)
    if plan:
        good, why = check_plan(plan, N, links, caps, parts, demands, period, envelope)
        if good:
            ok += 1
            print('seed %d: prepared %.2fs routes=%d recipes=%d trees=%d' % (
                seed, dt, len(plan['routes']), len(plan['recipes']), len(plan['trees'])))
        else:
            fail += 1
            print('seed %d: INVALID PLAN %s' % (seed, why))
    else:
        fail += 1
        print('seed %d: denied (cut size %s) %.2fs' % (seed, len(cut) if cut else None, dt))
print('ok', ok, 'fail', fail, 'worst %.2fs' % worst)
PYEOF
